judges.name: Non-Fast-Forward Zombie Fence Judge
judges.invariant: A zombie instance whose lease expired can never overwrite branch progress made by a subsequent holder.
judges.details: Git's native non-fast-forward push rejection stops the zombie writer. Compile-time NoForcePushGuardSpec ensures --force is never used.

judges.name: Total Shape Classification and Single Owner Judge
judges.invariant: BranchShape and TrackerShape are closed sets of 10 sealed records where every shape maps to exactly one recovery owner.
judges.details: Every frozen intermediate state is deterministically routed without improvising or crash-looping.

judges.name: Intent-Effect-Receipt Park Delivery Judge
judges.invariant: Terminal park commits pending marker to branch before tracker mutation, and confirms with receipt after.
judges.details: Next claimant detects isOrphanedPark, probes tracker idempotently via fenceParkDelivery, delivers if absent, and commits confirmTerminalWrite without running engine.

judges.name: Claim Epoch Provenance Judge
judges.invariant: Claim epoch in branch commit is writer provenance only and does not quarantine reclaims.
judges.details: Tested with RECLAIM_EPOCH 9000L; reclaiming instance classifies tips stamped by ended tenures by content alone and converges without quarantine.

judges.name: Reopened Finished Task Guard Judge
judges.invariant: Delivered branch cannot be corrupted by manual reopening of finished tracker issue.
judges.details: TakeDisposition intercepts TrackerTaskState.Ready when finished() is true, sends tracker.declineFinished, and refuses task.
